findings.claim: Q1 FY27：全年北美預期低個位數成長；歐洲對EMEA消費需求持審慎觀點，含能源價格與美國關稅逆風；中國成長逾40%
findings.excerpt: Picicci said the company’s outlook “maintains a prudent view of consumer demand in EMEA,” and includes the expectation of certain headwinds resulting from energy pricing changes and U.S. tariffs. “By region for fiscal 2027, we still expect North America revenue to grow approximately low single digits,” Picicci told analysts.

end_markets.note: Q1 FY27(2026-08)報導稱北美全年指引約低個位數、歐洲對消費需求持審慎(來源fashionunited/retaildive，未取得逐字原文)；市佔僅有粗估(<2% of ~$400B premium/luxury)，無第三方產業對照。Apparel TAM consensus未查得。 線索 1 條，程式核實 1 條
